reference_sql:
SELECT product_id
FROM promotion_products
WHERE promo_id = 1
UNION
SELECT product_id
FROM promotion_products
WHERE promo_id = 2
alternatives: SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM promotion_products WHERE promo_id IN (1, 2)
SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products WHERE promo_id = 2 UNION SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products WHERE promo_id = 1

other_way.sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM promotion_products WHERE promo_id IN (1, 2)
other_way.tradeoff: DISTINCT with IN gives the same list from one table, but UNION also merges lists that come from different tables.
